create_Node_root: create a root Node instance with is_root=True for MCTS tree search
train_Node_classifier: train the Node classifier using bag samples and split data into good and bad kid groups
predict_Node_split: predict and split the Node bag into good and bad kid data using the classifier
sample_arch_Node: sample a random architecture from the Node bag and remove it for evaluation
get_uct_Node: get the UCT score of a Node for MCTS selection with configurable exploration constant
